headline: Junior Data Analyst

notes: Thesis: Rainfall and rice yield in Lanao del Sur municipalities, a regression study

summary: Statistics graduate now working as a junior data analyst for a microfinance foundation. I turn branch loan records into Power BI reports, check the numbers with SQL, and use statistical tests to answer questions from managers. I want to keep building analysis that helps field offices decide where to focus.

projects.name: Rainfall and rice yield study
projects.description: Built a panel of ten years of municipal harvest and rainfall figures, fitted multiple regression models and presented the results to the provincial agriculture office.

projects.name: Barangay population explorer
projects.description: A Python notebook using pandas and matplotlib to compare census counts across barangays in Lanao del Sur.

skills: Data visualization with Power BI and Excel charts
Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, XLOOKUP, Power Query)

experience.title: Junior Data Analyst
bullets: Built Power BI reports that track repayment by municipality for 11 branch offices.
Write SQL queries against the loan system to prepare weekly portfolio-at-risk figures.
Tested whether attendance at financial-literacy sessions was linked to on-time repayment and shared the results with branch managers.
Cleaned and reconciled branch Excel files every month before they were loaded for reporting.
